title: GL-09 — Auto Scaling
stopChargesPanel: Scale the ASG to 0 and force-delete it, wait until it is gone (its instances terminate with it), then delete the launch template. This lab uses the default VPC and creates no security group or subnet.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on Auto Scaling; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Accept cost risk
bullets: In the lab card, open the cost-risk box and type `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` exactly as shown.
Success: the UI records your confirmation before any hourly resource is created.
Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.

steps.title: Default VPC subnet
bullets: Run `$VpcId = aws ec2 describe-vpcs --filters Name=isDefault,Values=true --query "Vpcs[0].VpcId" --output text`.
Run `$SubnetId = aws ec2 describe-subnets --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VpcId --query "Subnets[0].SubnetId" --output text`.
Success: ids are set.

steps.title: Launch template
bullets: Run `$AmiId = aws ssm get-parameters --names /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 --query "Parameters[0].Value" --output text`.
Save gl09-lt.json with ImageId `$AmiId`, InstanceType t3.micro, Tag LabId gl-09.

Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; $Gl09Lt = @{ ImageId = $AmiId; InstanceType = 't3.micro'; TagSpecifications = @(@{ ResourceType = 'instance'; Tags = @(@{ Key = 'LabId'; Value = 'gl-09' }) }) }; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl09-lt.json", ($Gl09Lt | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress), $utf8)`.
Run `$LaunchTemplateId = aws ec2 create-launch-template --launch-template-name workbook-gl09 --launch-template-data file://gl09-lt.json --query LaunchTemplate.LaunchTemplateId --output text`.
Success: launch template id is set.

steps.title: Create ASG desired 1
bullets: Run `$AsgName = "workbook-gl09-asg"`.

Run `aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=$LaunchTemplateId,Version=1 --min-size 1 --max-size 1 --desired-capacity 1 --vpc-zone-identifier $SubnetId --tags Key=LabId,Value=gl-09,PropagateAtLaunch=true Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab,PropagateAtLaunch=true`.
Success: ASG shows InService instance.

steps.title: Scale to zero
bullets: Run `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --min-size 0 --max-size 0 --desired-capacity 0`.
Wait until no instances remain in the group.
Success: desired capacity is 0.

steps.title: Delete ASG
bullets: Run `aws autoscaling delete-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --force-delete`.
Success: describe-auto-scaling-groups is empty for the name.

steps.title: Delete launch template
bullets: Run `aws ec2 delete-launch-template --launch-template-id $LaunchTemplateId`.
Success: template is gone.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Confirm you typed `I ACCEPT THE COST RISK` in the card before any hourly create.
Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.

Launch templates and the Auto Scaling group itself carry no charge; the t3.micro instance the group launches bills hourly while it exists. Scaling to 0 stops that hourly charge, but the ASG resource still exists until you delete it in step s10.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: ASG (scale to 0, force-delete, then poll every 15 seconds, up to 60 tries, until it is gone; this also terminates its instances), launch template. The AWS CLI has no Auto Scaling waiter, so Stop charges uses a short capped loop
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-09` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: if ($AsgName) { aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --min-size 0 --max-size 0 --desired-capacity 0; aws autoscaling delete-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name $AsgName --force-delete }

if ($AsgName) { $i = 0; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $AsgLeft = aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-names $AsgName --query "length(AutoScalingGroups)" --output text; $i++ } while ($AsgLeft -and $AsgLeft -ne '0' -and $i -lt 60); if ($i -ge 60) { Write-Host 'Timed out waiting for the ASG to delete after 60 tries; check the Auto Scaling console before deleting the launch template' } }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-09 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-09 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-09. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Launch template plus Auto Scaling group at desired 1, validate, scale to 0, delete.
